subject: Pallet tipped, 12 cases crushed
body: SO-20813 showed up at Building 4 yesterday with pallet 1 tipped over.
12 cases of the 18 inch film are crushed and unusable.
We need those 12 replaced asap, we're out on the floor.

truth.handling: The carrier noted 12 crushed cases, and replacing them comes to $696.00, over the $500 reship cap, so it waits for you.
